[[Radi]] crafts [[Norn armor]] for all professions, as well as [[Highlander Woad]] and [[Norn Woad]]. He will only craft armor for characters who reach the fifth [[Norn rank]], Slayer of Wurms. All armor is crafted with an empty [[insignia slot]].

==Location==
*[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Gunnar's Hold}}

==Dialogue==
Before attaining rank 5 on the Norn title track:
:''"Well, if it isn't <character name>. We've heard tales of your adventures, traveler, but they are short fiction compared to the epic deeds of the Norn. If you want my help, then you must prove your strength by becoming a Slayer of Wurms."''
